description: Search Amazon and get structured results — product titles, ASINs, prices, ratings, thumbnails. Example: scraperapi_amazon_search({ query: "wireless earbuds", country: "us", tld: "com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

country.description: Two-letter country code for proxy geotargeting, e.g. "us". Optional.

tld.description: Amazon marketplace top-level domain, e.g. "com", "co.uk". Optional (default com).

name: scraperapi_amazon_search
title: Scraperapi Amazon Search
